column1: # EXPLORATORY, NOT THE RUN OF RECORD (ruling R7, extended 2026-09-07). gpt-oss-20b alone
# on ONE h100-47 card. The pinned a100-80 run of record is job 826600, queued since 13:37
# with a scheduler start estimate of 2026-09-10; the h200-141 exploratory line is blocked
# behind 826597 because that pool's per-user cap is one card. h100-47 has its own cap of
# 4, ten nodes of four cards, and at 14:5x one of them (xgpi20) reads idle, so this line
# can answer the same question sooner without taking anything the sweep or the pinned
# judges need. R7's own words: when a pool is saturated a judge may run elsewhere as an
# exploratory line, and the run of record is always the pinned line.
# The mxfp4 question this row also settles: job 826026's server log said "Using 'TRITON'
# Mxfp4 MoE backend" and "Model loading took 13.03 GiB" on an a100-80, so vLLM neither
# refused the quantization nor dequantized to bf16 there. Whether the same holds on this
# card class is not known, and the server log line is what says so either way.
# BCF_REPO and BCF_ENV_SH are pinned to ~/bcf/repo-jury-h100 ON PURPOSE. judge_serve.sbatch
# defaults both to ~/bcf/repo-jury, which is the tree the W2f lane's own jobs read; a job
# of this lane must never read or write it.
# Wall 08:00:00 is inside gpu-long's 72 h ceiling (h100-47 lives in gpu-long, unlike the
# single h200 node, which sits in the 3 h `gpu` partition).
# ANSWERED, 15:44, job 826859: vLLM did NOT refuse mxfp4 on this card class. The server log
# reads `quantization=gpt_oss_mxfp4` and "Using 'TRITON' Mxfp4 MoE backend", the same
# backend as on the a100-80. That job still died, exit 5, and not over the quantization:
# "ValueError: No available memory for the cache blocks". The card Slurm hands out for
# `--gpus=h100-47` is a MIG 3g.47gb slice of an H100 NVL, and the section 6.1 fraction for
# gpt-oss-20b is 0.25 because that table co-hosted it with Gemma on one a100-80. 0.25 of
# 47 GB is 11.7 GB, under the 13.03 GiB the weights take, so the model loads and the KV
# cache gets nothing. BCF_JUDGE_GPU_UTIL below is the fix, and judge_serve.sbatch takes it
# ONLY from a row whose BCF_SERVING_LINE starts with `exploratory` (exit 12 otherwise), so
# a run of record cannot pick up a fraction the pre-registered table does not state.
gpt-oss-20b
